quote: Alates 01.07.2025 on Eestis käibemaksu standardmäär 24%. — From 1 July 2025 the standard VAT rate in Estonia is 24%. ('Käibemaksuseadusest tulenevalt on Eestis käibemaksumäärad 24%, 13%, 9% ja 0%.')
source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet (Estonian Tax and Customs Board) — Käibemaksumäärad ja maksuvaba käive

reduced_rates.scope: accommodation and accommodation with breakfast (from 2025-01-01, previously 9%)
books, press publications (from 2025-01-01, previously 5%), medicines and medical devices for disabled persons
exports, intra-EU supplies and other zero-rated supplies

notes: Per EMTA the standard rate rose from 22% to 24% on 2025-07-01. An opposition (Isamaa) bill of 18.06.2025 to cut the rate back to 22% from 2026 was not enacted; EMTA still states 24%. TEDB cross-check: 24% standard; 13% and 9% reduced — consistent.
